lyrics:
[Intro]
Splish splash, hello, Sprout!

[Verse 1]
Sprout played out in the muddy rain,
Look at those hands, a muddy stain!
Turn on the water, nice and warm,
Squeeze the soap and make it foam!

[Chorus]
Rub rub, palms together,
Scrub the backs, now that's much better!
Wiggle fingers in between,
Bubbles, bubbles, squeaky clean!

[Verse 2]
Sing along and count with me,
Thumbs and nails, one, two, three!
Rinse the bubbles down the drain,
Dry your hands, they're clean again!

[Chorus]
Rub rub, palms together,
Scrub the backs, now that's much better!
Wiggle fingers in between,
Bubbles, bubbles, squeaky clean!

[Outro]
Clean hands, happy Sprout! Yay!
